capabilities: Insert a video's transcript at the cursor, replacing a selected YouTube link or a pasted link
Create a new note from a transcript with source, channel, language and tags as properties
Show the remaining credit balance on the linked service
Configure caption language, clickable timestamps and the folder for new notes
extras: Freemium: 100 free credits on signup, then paid plans from $5/month; 1 credit per successful transcript. The README warns not to sync or share the plugin data file containing the API key, and notes transcripts are untrusted text written by video uploaders. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull a YouTube video's transcript into a note, so users must fetch and format it manually.
summary: Transcript-fetching plugin that inserts a YouTube video's transcript into a note or creates a new note from it via getyoutubetranscript.com.
